Diesel trucks continued to dominate in 2024, accounting for 95.1% of new EU registrations, 
despite a 6.2% decline. Electrically chargeable truck registrations fell by 4.6%, with their 
market share remaining stable at 2.3% compared to last year.  
New EU electrically chargeable bus registrations rose by 26.8% in 2024, with the market 
share increasing from 15.9% to 18.5%. Hybrid-electric bus sales fell by 16.1%, making up a 
9.8% share. Diesel bus registrations grew by 11.1%, increasing their market share to 63.1%, 
up 1 percentage point compared to 2023.
